rule_index.meaning: actual frozen rule-top candidate index in supplied candidate order, not necessarily0; runtime available, no correctness label

scores.meaning: ranking score including supplied base_prior; not calibrated probability

acceptance_logits.meaning: independent acceptance logits, not automatically calibrated

proposal_index.meaning: argmax current raw ranking scores among valid candidates; ties firstindex; tracks current model each call

adopt_logit.meaning: proposal-specific beneficial replacement logit; independent-calibration positive affine transform already folded into delivered final policy linear layer; sigmoid is calibrated evidence, not a correctness guarantee; external threshold/protected veto integration pending

candidate_mapping: Output j corresponds exactly to external stable candidate ID at input row j. Keep an external ordered ID array. No IDs or targets are model features. Both outputs are -10000 on padded candidates. Discard padded outputs before selection.
tokenization: vocab.json tokens array; 0 padding; Unicode scalar known at index>=257 uses that ID, otherwise emit UTF8 bytes+1 (1..256). No Unicode normalization. ASCII lowercase raw only for pinyin; preserve English/mixed case. committed context keeps last96 IDs, raw first96, candidate text first32, reading first96. Right-pad zeros. Empty string [0]. Out-of-vocab ID outside0..8191 is invalid.
feature_precision: Round each of the 18 scalars to IEEE754 binary16 then expand to float32 before model input, matching frozen V3 cache.
consumption: Ranges are supplied by frozen candidate generator and measured on actual raw input Unicode scalar offsets, never intended or completed spelling.

deployment.all_meaning: allowed system scheduling; not evidence that ANE was used

calibration.adoption_logit_transform: positive scale+bias fitted only on independent calibration, folded into delivered policy.2 weight and bias; invalid/no-action remains -10000

needs: Map host real candidates and all required metadata to this exact feature contract
Supply actual rule identity even when not index0, plus stable snapshot/revision
Committed context is real preceding text; no synthesized unrelated/future context
Compile the supplied mlpackage in the existing iOS build and include resources in keyboard-extension target
Verify Swift encoder vs fixed vectors and Apple CoreML outputs vs source reference
Wire threshold/protected veto once; old product gates are not presumed equivalent
integration_required.unresolved: Actual App candidate feature compatibility has not been inspected; all adapter differences remain integration_required. Never fill unknown metadata with guessed constants.

policy.proposal: current scores argmax, never cached old-model proposal
policy.decision: Apply existing raw-derived protected-literal veto. If vetoed, proposal equals rule, rule invalid, or adoption evidence below delivered threshold, keep actualrule; otherwise take proposal. No label, intendedinput or futuretext allowed.
policy.protected_input_veto: external existing frozen raw-input protection for URLs, identifiers and protected literals remains required; derive from available actual input, never gold
policy.threshold_location: metadata for runtime integration; model package exposes raw logit, does not silently change old product runtime
policy.adoption_target_training_only: 1 exactly when actual current proposal is acceptable, actual rule is unacceptable, proposal differs from rule and input is not protected; all other caseskeep; this label never enters forward
policy.both_acceptable: keep is trained to avoid pointless substitution
policy.both_wrong: keep label does not count as correct outcome; final accuracy remains wrong
policy.no_gold: ranking masked, policy teachesreject unsupported replacement

network_extension.base: V9 best_rank step23739 unchanged encoder/ranker and existing V6-origin proposal-policy architecture
network_extension.inference_runtime_dependency: standard CoreML ops only; no Python or custom CUDA
network_extension.existing_policy: existing 1032 -> 128 ReLU -> 1, initialized from V6 step160219; trained only on isolated selector_fit; calibration changes final linear values without adding parameters

training_protocol: policy-only selector_fit training; frozen V9 rank; independent calibration affine folded into policy final linear; one locked final holdout

encoding_details.known_scalar_ids: Use vocab.tokens index>=257; one Unicode scalar, never a grapheme or UTF16 unit
encoding_details.unknown_or_special: No extra BOS/EOS/UNK is inserted. Unknown scalar expands into UTF8 byte IDs. Special-looking token strings are not parsed as macros.
encoding_details.normalization: No NFC/NFKC, no trimming, no whitespace/punctuation removal, no ü/v rewriting, no traditional/simplified conversion
encoding_details.raw_input_case: Python str.lower only in pinyin mode; English/mixed preserve case
encoding_details.truncation: After tokenization, context tail96; raw head96; candidate text head32; reading head96. Right-pad zeros.
encoding_details.length_units: Token lengths are UTF8-fallback token count. Feature string lengths and actual consumed ranges are Unicode scalar count.
encoding_details.version_note: Source Python Unicode15.0; Swift/Apple Unicode case-fold equivalence pending. Tokenizer edge vectors included.
encoding_details.empty_strings: All-zero sequence; mean uses nonzero tokens and denominator clamped to1

candidate_adapter.external_identity: Stable ID stays outside neural tensors. candidate_ids contains text TOKEN IDs, not external candidate identities.
candidate_adapter.order: Keep input candidate order; output column j maps to the same external ID at j. Do not sort first or assume actual rule is column0.
candidate_adapter.rule: Look up rule_id in the original snapshot; pass that index as rule_index. Missing/duplicate IDs are errors. If rule lies outside unchanged first32, retain rule without inference.
candidate_adapter.truncation: Take unchanged first32, mask padding. Do not insert target or pull a candidate from below32 for validation or this interface.
candidate_adapter.native_precision: frequency/edit_cost are original Float32 reference-decoder values; base_rank is original integer rule rank. Do not substitute neural rank.
candidate_adapter.ranges: [start,end) on ACTUAL raw Unicode scalar offsets. 0<=start<=end<=raw_scalar_count. Not the intended/corrected/expanded reading length.
candidate_adapter.partial_consumption: Prefix/association/partial-consumption candidates are retained under the original contract; this export adds no new full-consumption veto.
candidate_adapter.base_prior: Calculated once before the model; graph already adds it to scores. Never add again after inference.
candidate_adapter.invalid: Pad token IDs/features/prior with0, valid_mask=0; real candidates mask=1. Discard padded outputs even though graph emits -10000.
candidate_adapter.truth_excluded: No acceptable-answer set, intended text, correctness flag, future text or gold-present label enters runtime input.

order: Validate snapshot and actual rule ID
Encode first32 and infer all4 outputs
proposal_index is current scores argmax among valid candidates, first index wins ties
If proposal!=rule AND p>=Float32(0.65), adopt proposal; otherwise retain actual rule
Verify revision still current before applying the mapped preferred external ID
deterministic_decision.notes: acceptance_logits and score/margin/softmax are policy evidence inside the graph, not additional runtime thresholds. No second temperature, scale, bias or base_prior.
deterministic_decision.output_scope: Defines preferred candidate only. No implicit replacement of the host whole candidate list, committing text or discarding existing IME features.

protected_input.swift_translation: ICU letters/numbers/underscore for Python w, Nd for Python d; see isProtected. Apple parity pending.

runtime_dependency_closure.required_code: Sources/*.swift or an equivalent implementation of this exact contract
runtime_dependency_closure.optional_reference: OptionalCandidateReference/ supplies the frozen V3 candidate-feature reference and assets; not automatically a replacement for the host engine.
